controls.title: Controls & Combat Guide
controls.body:
Move (Side-Scroll / 8-Dir Top-Down): Joystick / WASD / Arrows
3-Hit Sword Combo (Eclipse Finisher breaks shields): Chain ATK / J / Z
Shadow Guard & Perfect Parry (reflects orbs + Riposte): GUARD / C / X
Shadow Dodge (invulnerability frames): DODGE / Shift / K
Jump, Double Jump & Wall Jump: JUMP / Space (Down+Jump drops bridge)
Top-Down Sprint: Ctrl / L2  |  Interact (Rift / Runestone): E / F / ACT
Switch Camera & Mode: MODE / Tab / M  |  Pause: Esc / Back
hud.hint_sidescroll: Chain 3-Hit Combos, Parry orbs & slay cliff foes. Cross a Rift or tap MODE to challenge the Sanctum Boss.
hud.hint_topdown: Defeat the courtyard vanguard & approach the North Seal to confront Vaelor, Warden of the Eclipse!
hud.hint_rift_ready: Shadow Rift in range! Press E / tap ACT or MODE to shift camera & mode.
hud.hint_lore_ready: Ancient Runestone nearby! Press E or tap ACT to read its inscription.
hud.parry_success: Perfect Guard! Stamina & MP restored — next slash is a Riposte!
hud.player_fallen: Fallen in battle! Reviving at the Sanctum Seal...
boss.phase_shift_2: Vaelor shatters his seal — Phase II: Shattered Halo!
boss.phase_shift_3: Vaelor unleashes the Eternal Eclipse — Phase III!
boss.defeated: VICTORY! Vaelor, Warden of the Eclipse has been vanquished!
lore.west_tablet: West Runestone: "Two realms overlap in the Twilight Sanctum — leap the outer cliffs or walk the inner seal."
lore.east_tablet: East Runestone: "Shatter an Obsidian Sentinel's shield with the third Eclipse Cut, or parry a Rift Arcanist's orb."
